# RFC 9421 test data

This directory contains deterministic test fixtures derived from RFC 9421
Appendix B. The files are generated by `scripts/generate_rfc_fixtures.py`
(no network access, byte-stable across runs) and verified by
`scripts/verify_rfc_fixtures.py`.

Files:

- `SOURCE.json` — provenance metadata for the fixtures.
- `request_cases.json` — the RFC `test-request` message.
- `response_cases.json` — the RFC `test-response` message.
- `signature_input_cases.json` — Appendix B Signature-Input values.
- `signature_cases.json` — Appendix B Signature values (B.2.5 HMAC).
- `signature_base_cases.json` — Appendix B signature bases (byte-exact).
- `hmac_cases.json` — HMAC-SHA256 vectors including the B.2.5 example.
- `negative_cases.json` — negative structured-field parsing cases.
